zh: 两段各自排序后内部都已经非降，拼接后唯一可能出问题的地方是两段的交界处。
交界处没有逆序，当且仅当前段的最大值不超过后段的最小值。
先从右往左求后缀最小值数组 suffix。再从左往右维护前缀最大值，对每个切口 i（前段为 0..i，i 从 0 到 n−2），若前缀最大值 ≤ suffix[i+1] 则计数加一。
en: After sorting each part on its own, both parts are non-decreasing inside, so the only place the concatenation can fail is the boundary between them.
The boundary has no inversion exactly when the maximum of the left part is at most the minimum of the right part.
Build the suffix-minimum array from the right. Then scan from the left keeping the prefix maximum; for each cut after index i (i from 0 to n−2), count it when the prefix maximum is ≤ suffix[i+1].

explanationEn:
## Idea

Precompute the minimum of every suffix and scan the prefix maximum; a cut is valid when the prefix maximum is at most the suffix minimum.

## Correctness

After sorting, each part is already non-decreasing inside, so the only possible inversion is between the two parts; the left part's maximum not exceeding the right part's minimum rules out every such inversion.

## Complexity

O(n) time, O(n) space.
